svg.title: Why trust DSB?
svg.desc: Five foundations for delegation; read the README and threat model for limits. Trust comes before delegation. / Risky decisions / stay with you / Execution gates / Pay / send / delete / authorize / No duplicate work / Can stop / Task ledger / task_id + confirmed process exit / Review what / happened / Audit log / Reasons for allow / refuse / Your main screen / stays yours / Virtual display / Third-party apps in the background / Goal: other apps / cannot command it / Local authentication / Self-install: TCP 5037 exposure / Not a safety guarantee: OCR / vision can be wrong; control-plane cutover is not fully accepted.

g.aria-label: Not a safety guarantee: OCR / vision can be wrong; control-plane cutover is not fully accepted.
